summaryZh: 天体物理与宇宙学研究组研究星系、恒星和宇宙结构的起源、演化及命运，涉及暗物质、暗能量和基本作用力。团队结合理论模型、模拟和观测数据。
researchQuestions: 暗物质与暗能量的本质是什么？

evidence.quote: The Astrophysics & Cosmology Group At the forefront of scientific exploration, our Astrophysics & Cosmology research delves into the mysteries of the universe, investigating the birth, evolution, and ultimate fate of galaxies, stars, and cosmic structures. Our interdisciplinary approach combines theoretical models, advanced simulations, and observational data to unravel the enigmatic nature of dark matter, dark energy, and the fundamental forces that shape the cosmos. From probing the cosmic microwave background radiation to studying gravitational waves, we strive to deepen humanity's understanding of the universe's origin and the vast cosmic tapestry that surrounds us. Professors Kam S. Arnold Patrick H. Diamond Raphael Flauger George M. Fuller Dan Green Kim Griest Michael Holst Brian Keating Dusan Keres Tongyan Lin Shelley A. Wright Emeriti Lee Lindblom Thomas W. Murphy
